title: Scatterplot with marginal histograms
intent: Compare a bivariate relationship while retaining the one-dimensional distribution of each measure.

source.title: Observable Plot bin transform and rect mark

ai.create: Create a joint scatterplot with a top histogram for x and a right histogram for y, using explicit embedded regions and the same raw observations for all three views.
ai.maintain: Change the bin boundaries while retaining complete boundary semantics, responsive shared scales, inferred fields, and separate scatter and marginal regions.
